subject: Pilot extension: temporary burst license exchange
messages:
From: Alyssa Romero <alyssa@pegasus.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Wang <tom.wang@pegasus.ai>
Date: Sat, 17 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension request — short burst + packaging question

Hi Jasmine,

Quick note from our product team: as we run the final throughput/edge-case tests this week, we need a short burst window to complete large-scale evaluation scenarios. Can we extend the current 30-day pilot by 2 weeks and add a temporary burst allocation (additional 150k tokens of priority capacity)?

We need to understand the commercial tradeoffs — would you prefer we take a time extension (two extra weeks) or buy token credits for the burst? If credits, what's pricing and is there a pilot-only discount? I attached our token burn export so you can see the expected shape (Pegasus_PO_Counts.csv).

Also flagged: security is asking for a short amendment rather than a new contract (so a 1–2 page amendment is ideal).

Appreciate a quick ballpark — we want to schedule the final test for next Wed/Thu.

Thanks,
Alyssa Romero
Director of ML Platforms
Pegasus Health

Attachment: Pegasus_PO_Counts.csv (csv)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Romero <alyssa@pegasus.ai>
Cc: Tom Wang <tom.wang@pegasus.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 17 May 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request — short burst + packaging question

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the heads-up and for the token export. We can absolutely support a short burst window. Two immediate approaches we see working well:

- Time extension: add 14 calendar days to the pilot, keep the same rate card and access tier, and we grant short-term priority scheduling for your queued jobs for the extension window.
- Credit add-on: pre-purchase an incremental credit pack that covers the 150k burst tokens (we can apply a pilot-tier discount).

Both options are fine operationally; the typical customer ask is whether they prefer predictability (time extension) or token-granular control (credits). If you expect the burst to be concentrated into a few big runs, credits may be cleaner.

Ben, David — can you run numbers here? Alyssa, if you can confirm the expected traffic pattern (all within 48 hours vs spread across 2 weeks) that would help pricing. I’ll draft a 1‑page amendment template we can push through once we agree.

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: proposed burst pricing for Pegasus (DEAL-8742) — approval request

Team,

Summary of ask: Pegasus wants a 2-week extension + 150k token burst. They are strategic (healthcare vertical) and likely to convert to Dedicated in Q3 if evaluation goes well. I modeled two options:

1) Time extension (14 days): no incremental token charge, but we reserve priority scheduling. Standard internal policy: no discount for pure time extensions.
2) Credit pack: 150k tokens at pilot-tier list $0.0025/token = $375. Pilot discount band typically 15% -> $318.75.

Given the strategic upside, I propose we offer a 20% pilot discount on the credit pack (final = $300) OR a complimentary 7-day priority window plus a reduced rate for the other 7 days. This exceeds my standard discount authority (15%). Requesting approval to grant up to 25% if we pair it with a signed 60‑day conversion intent note (non-binding).

Reason to approve higher discount: Pegasus' expected ARR and the healthcare compliance lift they will validate with us.

Attachments: simple calc (inline below)
- 150k * $0.0025 = $375
- 20% off = $300
- 25% off = $281.25

Kimberly — can you approve 20% (or 25% with the conversion note)? If yes, I’ll prepare the 1-page amendment and route to legal for quick sign-off.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Executive
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: proposed burst pricing for Pegasus (DEAL-8742) — approval request

Ben — thanks for the clear breakdown. Approve up to 20% off the pilot credit pack (final = $300) without additional strings. If you want to push to 25% that needs a written conversion intent (short note) and Finance sign-off — not automatic.

Also suggest packaging an extra 4 hours of engineering support (priority troubleshooting) during the burst at no charge instead of increasing the discount — that preserves margin and often beats a deeper price concession from a perception standpoint.

Please prepare the 1-page amendment with the following bullets for Legal:
- 14 day extension dates (start/end)
- 150k token credit allocation with 20% pilot discount
- Priority scheduling clause for the burst window
- 4 hours of engineering support included during the burst
- Acceptance via DocuSign by both parties

Route to Legal and Finance for signature routing once drafted. Good call on the conversion intent offer as an optional add-on.

Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Ops
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the export and the context. Internal approvals completed. Proposed offer (short and sweet):

- 14 calendar day extension to your pilot (start: 2025-05-24, end: 2025-06-06)
- 150,000 token burst credit at pilot-tier price with a 20% discount (total = $300)
- Priority scheduling for your burst runs during the extension window
- 4 hours of engineering support included to help with job tuning and monitoring during the burst

I attached a one-page amendment (Pilot_Amendment_v1.docx) and a token burn export we reviewed. If that looks good, sign via the DocuSign link below and we’ll enable the extension and credits the morning after we get the signed amendment.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example/DEAL-8742/amendment
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/DEAL-8742

Thanks — we’ll be standing by to coordinate the exact test window and ensure priority scheduling.

Best,
